description: Migration script for cross-filter global scoping in Superset, using Alembic for database schema migration. Contains upgrade and downgrade functions to modify dashboard JSON metadata related to cross-filter scope settings.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing dashboards with json_metadata field.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs migration to update dashboard json_metadata for cross-filter scope.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the migration changes to dashboard json_metadata related to cross-filter scope.
